entry.title: How to Stop AI From Ruining Your Architecture
entry.summary:
We are witnessing a new phenomenon in AI-assisted teams: The Principle of Zero-Cost Erosion. Pre-AI: Cost(Patch) > Cost(Refactor) -> Trigger to Refactor.
Post-AI: Cost(Patch) ~ 0 -> Never Refactor.
This economic imbalance leads to "Zero-Cost Erosion," where systems degrade rapidly because "just one more if-statement" is always the path of least resistance. Beyond the obvious technical debt, this erosion creates two invisible taxes on your team. First, there's the Token Tax: unrefactored, verbose code consumes more tokens in the context window, making every future interaction with that file more expensive (in API costs) and less intelligent (because the context window is filled with noise). Refactoring is an investment in cheaper, smarter future agents. Second, there's the Reviewer's A…

entry.title: Bastillion: A Web-Based SSH Console and Key Management Tool
entry.summary:
Bastillion: A Deep Dive into a Free, Open-Source Web-Based SSH Console and Key Management Tool In the realm of system administration and cybersecurity, efficient and secure access management is paramount. Bastillion emerges as a powerful, free, and open-source solution that addresses these needs head-on. This web-based tool provides a centralized platform for managing SSH access across a diverse range of systems, offering an intuitive and accessible alternative to traditional command-line methods. At its core, Bastillion functions like a sophisticated bastion host, but with a significant advantage: a clean, user-friendly dashboard accessible directly through a web browser. This design choice democratizes SSH management, making it more approachable for teams of all sizes and technical proficiencies. Key Features and Benefits: Web-Based Accessibility: Manage your SSH connections and keys from anywhere, anytime, using just a web browser. This eliminates the need for specialized client software and simplifies remote management. Centralized SSH Key Management: Securely store, organize, and rotate SSH keys for all your servers from a single point of control. This enhances security posture by reducing the number of distributed key files. Intuitive Dashboard: Bastillion's interface is designed for clarity and ease of use, providing a visual overview of your SSH access configurations. Open-Source and Community Driven: As a free and open-source project, Bastillion benefits from the collective expertise of its community. Contributions are welcome, fostering continuous improvement and innovation. Bastillion represents a significant step forward for open-source tools in the cybersecurity space. Its combination of functionality, ease of use, and cost-effectiveness makes it an invaluable asset for any organization looking to strengthen its SSH security and streamline its operations.

But the company kept iterating on the models, expanding its reinforcement learning (RL) runs, to create Olmo 3.1. The new Olmo 3.1 models focus on efficiency, transparency, and control for enterprises. Ai2 updated two of the three versions of Olmo 2: Olmo 3.1 Think 32B, the flagship model optimized for advanced research, and Olmo 3.1 Instruct 32B, designed for instruction-following, multi-turn dialogue, and tool use. Olmo 3 has a third version, Olmo 3-Base for programming, comprehension, and math. It also works well for continue fine-tuning.
